records.issue_text: Migration 20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:3 uses create_table force: true, silently dropping and recreating an existing table and losing data on re-run
records.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration calls `create_table :embeddable_hosts, force: true`, which (per Rails behavior) will drop the table if it already exists before recreating it. That creates a real risk of data loss if the migration is re-run (e.g., reset/redo, partial deploy state, or manual execution) or if the table exists for any reason.
